MY JOURNEY

From hands-on development
to platform-level impact.

I’m a frontend and mobile engineering lead at LiSEC automation in Dubai. My work spans enterprise React applications, React Native mobile experiences, industrial device integrations, and the engineering practices behind them.

Alongside leading a team of 8–12, I contribute to platform standards and Agentic SDLC workflows: multi-model code review, quality gates, orchestration, and guardrails used in everyday development.

I’m also leading the modernization of a legacy React Native application toward a PWA architecture, with TDD-oriented development at its core.
